musical_notes.chord_format: chords_a and chords_b contain explicit pitches in semitones relative to tonic; prefer these over diatonic degree inference. Some cadences use an intentional raised leading tone.
musical_notes.form: 64 bars in 4/4: intro4, A16, B16, breakdown8, solo8, reprise8, turnaround4. Every part should have an audible role, with short gaps between phrases.
musical_notes.performance: Hooks are authored melodies. Preserve their intervals and rests; do not shuffle their notes or blindly snap them to each chord. Use hook_a with chords_a and hook_b with chords_b. A lead should sit clearly above the rhythm guitar, with one quieter answering voice at most.
musical_notes.arrangement: Intro reveals a rhythmic fragment. First A is one lead, second A adds a short quiet answer. B widens the harmony and uses longer lead tones. Breakdown drops rhythm guitar and most drums. Solo restates and embellishes the hook rather than random scales. Reprise restores the full band.
musical_notes.loop: Do not fade the complete track to silence. End with a four-bar turn over the appropriate A harmony and a pickup to bar1. Render reverb/delay tails periodically across the loop boundary, or use a short equal-power boundary crossfade.
musical_notes.mix: Keep kick and bass centered, guitar double-tracks modestly spread, lead near center, pads wide and quieter. The intent is melodic console action rock with supportive electronic textures, not an unchanging square-wave chiptune.

tracks.title: Molten Circuit
tracks.mode_name: E minor, with B major dominant
tracks.instrument: distorted melodic lead, palm-muted power guitars, sharp saw brass
tracks.description: 긴장감 있는 E단조 기타 리프와 위로 치솟는 신스 리드. 후렴에서 음가를 늘려 뜨거운 용암 성채의 규모감을 만든다.

groove.feel: Tight sixteenth-note palm-muted chugs; strong snare 2 and 4; tom pickup every eighth bar.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Begin with four bars of filtered guitar and kick, reveal lead at A. Half-time drums and low brass in breakdown. Reprise doubles the lead quietly one octave down.

tracks.title: Crystal Fault
tracks.mode_name: D minor, with A major dominant in B
tracks.instrument: thick square-saw lead, low distorted guitar, struck crystal bells
tracks.flavor: heavy cave groove with crystalline echoes
tracks.description: 묵직한 하프타임 리듬과 짧고 힘 있는 리드가 암석의 무게를 표현한다. 배경의 수정 벨은 빈 공간에만 짧게 울린다.

groove.feel: Heavy half-time backbeat on beat 3, with a sixteenth ghost-snare pickup. Chorus can return to snare on beats 2 and 4.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Let low toms and bell echoes establish depth in intro. Start B with a crash and full backbeat. Breakdown keeps a sub-octave bass riff and isolated crystal answers.

tracks.title: Canopy Voltage
tracks.instrument: bright plucked synth lead, muted funk guitar, woody percussion
tracks.description: A도리안의 밝은 6도와 엇박 리드로 덩굴 사이를 뛰어다니는 느낌. 우드 퍼커션과 짧은 기타 스트로크가 맞물린다.

groove.feel: Dry syncopated sixteenths; alternate left and right wood/conga hits, with a 3+3+2 accent across each two beats.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Intro is percussion and bass. Add lead and offbeat guitar at A. Let the B lead sustain a little longer and add a quiet airy synth answer. Breakdown is percussion plus a wood-pluck version of A.

tracks.title: Prism Blizzard
tracks.mode_name: F-sharp minor, with C-sharp major dominant
tracks.instrument: glass FM bell, smooth pulse lead, shimmering arpeggio and restrained guitar
tracks.description: 맑은 벨과 길게 흐르는 F#단조 멜로디. 차가운 공간감 위에 빠른 아르페지오와 단단한 드럼을 얹는다.

groove.feel: Steady eighth-note drive under a lyrical lead; glass arpeggio on alternate sixteenths, quieter than the melody.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Bell-only opening gains bass and drums across four bars. Keep A relatively spacious. Chorus adds sustained guitar fifths and octave lead support. Breakdown has bells and filtered pad without snare.

tracks.title: Tidal Relay
tracks.mode_name: C Dorian, with G major dominant in B
tracks.instrument: rounded FM electric-piano lead, liquid pulse synth, chorus guitar and slap-like bass
tracks.description: 수몰 유적의 청록빛을 닮은 FM 건반과 부드러운 리드. 7·9화음, 흐르는 베이스, 엇박 기타로 수상 테마만의 유연함을 만든다.

groove.feel: A tight straight-sixteenth funk groove with occasional ghost snare; chorus guitar stabs on offbeats and light rim taps.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Intro uses low-pass electric piano with a bubbling arpeggio. A stays dry and rhythmic. B opens the pad and lead while bass remains active. Breakdown exposes seventh-chord voicings and percussion.

tracks.title: Skyward Vector
tracks.instrument: bright soaring pulse lead, open power guitar, airy synth brass and sparkling arpeggio
tracks.description: 장조 계열의 상승 멜로디와 리디안의 열린 색채. 빠른 드럼과 밝은 기타가 구름 궁전 위로 도약하는 추진력을 만든다.

groove.feel: Fast straight eighth-note bass and energetic four-square backbeat; open hat before snare, short rising tom fills.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Intro starts with rising filtered arpeggio and a tom pickup. Keep A buoyant; B adds open guitar fifths, ride cymbal and wider pad. Breakdown hangs briefly on airy Em before returning to ascent.

tracks.title: Buried Sun Engine
tracks.instrument: nasal reed-like synth lead, metallic pluck, low distorted guitar and deep toms
tracks.description: 반음 장식이 있는 선법 멜로디와 낮은 기타, 깊은 탐 드럼. 오래된 사원 속 기계가 깨어나는 묵직하고 신비로운 분위기.

groove.feel: A 3+3+4+3+3 sixteenth-note guitar accent cycle against a normal rock backbeat; low toms answer the last melodic phrase.

tracks.arrangement_hint: Metal pluck and a low drone introduce the semitone motif. A brings in toms and muted guitar. B broadens to full sustained guitar and high lead. Breakdown isolates the pluck with sparse tom responses.
